The Subtask Name: Task Assignment and Planning
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Team Leader
  To_agent: Team Leader
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.95
  agent_explanation: The Team Leader analyzes the user's request, formulates a plan to assign the task to Alex, and executes commands to create the task and publish the message. This is a self-loop of reasoning and action within the same agent.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The Team Leader might enter an infinite loop of planning and re-planning without executing the assignment commands.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The task remains unassigned, and Alex never receives the instruction.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: N/A (no other agent is involved in this edge).

The Subtask Name: File Creation and Function Implementation
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Engineer
  To_agent: Engineer
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.9
  agent_explanation: The Engineer receives the task, plans the implementation, creates the file, and writes the function. This is a self-loop of reasoning and action within the same agent.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The Engineer might misinterpret the compression logic or write incorrect code.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The function will not compress strings correctly or will crash.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: N/A (no other agent is involved in this edge).

The Subtask Name: Task Completion
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Engineer
  To_agent: Engineer
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The Engineer verifies the implementation with tests, confirms success, and marks the task as finished. This is a self-loop of reasoning and action within the same agent.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Engineer incorrectly assumes the tests passed when they failed, the task will be marked complete with a broken solution.
      severity: 0.9
      if_from_agent_wrong: The solution is deployed incorrectly, and downstream users will encounter errors.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: N/A (no other agent is involved in this edge).
